MUST-FIX src/bulk.js:5: the discount condition is `qty > 10`, but the contract grants the 10 percent discount when "qty is 10 or more", so a 10-item line is charged full price (e.g. 10 × 100¢ returns 1000 instead of Math.round(900) = 900); smallest remediation is changing the test to `qty >= 10 ? MUST-FIX src/coupon.js:5: the discount divides by 1000 instead of 100, so every coupon is ten times too small (e.g. subtotal 10000, pct 10 → 100 instead of 1000), and checkout.js:6 inherits the error through couponCents, undercharging tax and total; smallest remediation is `Math.round((subtotal * p) / 100)`.

MUST-FIX src/invoice.js:5: the template interpolates the single sum `amount + taxCents(...)`, producing "label: 1080", but the contract specifies the string "label: amount+tax" with both values shown in integer cents (e.g. "label: 1000+80"); smallest remediation is `` `${label}: ${amount}+${taxCents(amount, rateBp)}` ``.
MUST-FIX src/bulk.js:4 uses `qty > 10` but the spec says "when qty is 10 or more the whole line is 10 percent cheaper"; qty === 10 incorrectly gets no discount; change to `qty >= 10`
